notes.title: Update notes for patch 1.0.9
notes.notes:
New Features
Added New Secret Unlocks:
Discover new secrets and hidden areas. Enjoy the thrill of finding and unlocking new content!

Bug Fixes
Fixed Menu Clipping Bug:
Resolved an issue that could cause a black screen when navigating the menu.

Improvements
Tweaked Shadowmen:
Adjusted the positions of some of the more challenging Shadowmen for a better gameplay experience.

notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Adjustments to the Shadowman's behavior have been made to enhance the gameplay experience. The Shadowman, previously a fleeting presence, will now initiate consequences for direct eye contact. Players are advised to exercise caution, as prolonged exposure may result in deadly repercussions.

Other fixes:
1. Added a new deadly train stop after the second platform in Episode 2.
2. More items added to Franks apartment.
3. Minor Audio tweaks and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.7
notes.notes:
We've just released version 1.0.7!
With this update, we have made some major changes to core player mechanics.

1. Support for room scale
We've added room-scale and the annoying "Out of bounds" message is now gone. The game is still played best stationery. 

2. Player speed tweaks
The player speed is now adjusted (faster), and should also be consistent on all headsets.

3. Updated physics
The physics detection calculations are improved, which means that you can now pick up a glass with the fork and spin it around 🙂

Besides this, we've also:

 done some minor graphical tweaks.
 fixed a bug where you could accidentally push through geometry.

If you find any bugs, please let us know in the Steam forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1999630/discussions/1/

Thank you for the feedback and support!
